say:3:1360010001:1.text: Wow, amazing! You kids totally brought the legendary story to life by defeating the monsters!
say:3:1360010001:1.source_cn: 哇，太棒了，孩子们，你们击退了怪兽，重演了过去的传说！

say:6:1360010002:1.text: Well, Florabelle, it was good, but... the "monsters" weren't really that scary this time.
say:6:1360010002:1.source_cn: 话是这么说，芙拉贝尔老师，这次的怪兽好像不太厉害呢！

say:7:1360010003:1.text: W-what do you mean, not scary?! Sir Chippy gave it his all!
say:7:1360010003:1.source_cn: 什、什么叫不太厉害？！骑士满满可是使出了全力的！

say:8:1360010004:1.text: All you did was make a few cute noises and say you were monsters. You didn't even bother to disguise yourselves! It wasn't scary at all!
say:8:1360010004:1.source_cn: 但你们只是发出了几声可爱的叫声，说自己是怪兽，一点伪装...

say:12:1360010006:1.text: We're hamsters, you know! Giant, talking hamsters attacking you—how is that not scary?!
say:12:1360010006:1.source_cn: 我、我们本来就是仓鼠使魔！会说话的仓鼠来攻击你们，还不...

say:13:1360010007:1.text: That's not the point, Chippy. We're familiars... Oh, forget it. Chippy gets silly when he's worked up.
say:13:1360010007:1.source_cn: 不是的，满满，我们是使魔呀……算了，满满一上头就会变成笨蛋。

say:16:1360010008:1.text: No! It's exactly because you're hamsters that you can't just half-heartedly do it!
say:16:1360010008:1.source_cn: 不！正是因为你们有着仓鼠的身躯，所以才更不能敷衍了事！

say:19:1360010009:1.text: Big Sister Lyca once made a giant monster out of vines. After we defeated it, a beautiful starlight display lit up the monster. It was so pretty!
say:19:1360010009:1.source_cn: 莱卡姐姐甚至会用藤条编出一整个大怪兽，在我们击败它之后...

say:22:1360010010:1.text: In monster battles, acting is everything... You have to give it your all... and really get into character...
say:22:1360010010:1.source_cn: 怪兽作战里，扮、扮演才是最重要的……用尽责的心……认真...

say:23:1360010011:1.text: Uh... uh... well, we were a little rushed and didn't use any costumes...
say:23:1360010011:1.source_cn: 呃……呃唔……确实，时间仓促，我们也确实没怎么打扮……
